rule: A won deal closed in 2026-Q3 counts as influenced when it shows at least 3 framework behaviours across at least 2 interactions after 2026-06-01, and at least one element moved from 0 or 1 to 2 or 3 in one of those interactions.
caveats: Six assessed deals and four closed ones are too few for the win-rate comparison to carry weight on its own.
Attribution is correlational: adoption after the training date may reflect deal stage as much as the training.
One deal (Granite upgrade) has no linked interactions and two interactions are unlinked; they are excluded from every number here.
